title: Inside the Launch of G-SHOCK’s First Fully Analog Watch in Singapore
summary: G-SHOCK takes on a new expression of toughness with the launch of its first fully analog 2500 Series in Singapore. Present at the launch were Ralph De Leon, Rei Germar, Miguel Romulo, and more.
